title: Finite equations of finite free sheaf maps shrink from a stalk
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $I$ a finite indexing type, and $A_i,B_i$ sheaves of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Each $A_i$ and $B_i$ is zero or isomorphic to a finite free sheaf [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let $y\in U\subseteq Y$ with $U$ open. Given maps $f_i,g_i:R_U A_i\to R_U B_i$, where $R_U$ is open restriction, suppose $S_U(f_i)=S_U(g_i)$, where $S_U$ is module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] along $U.\mathrm{fromSpecStalkOfMem}(y)$. Then there are an open $V\subseteq U$ containing $y$ and its inclusion $j:V\to U$ such that $R_j(f_i)=R_j(g_i)$ for all $i$. No complexes, differentials, or comparisons of stalk pullbacks are involved.

proof.text: Restriction preserves zero objects and finite free sheaves. For each index whose source and target are nonzero choose their finite bases on U and form the matrix of f_i minus g_i. Pullback of matrices applies the scheme map to every coefficient (Scheme.Modules.freeMatrix_pullback). The stalk scheme map has its section map equal to the germ map, through the global sections isomorphism of Spec O_(Y,y), by Scheme.fromSpecStalk_appTop and the open stalk isomorphism. Thus the assumed equality of pullbacks makes every matrix coefficient have zero germ.

For each of the finitely many coefficients apply the germ equality criterion, equivalently RingedSpace.exists_res_eq_zero_of_germ_eq_zero, and intersect the resulting neighbourhoods inside U. On V all coefficient restrictions vanish. The restricted matrices are therefore zero and the restricted maps agree, by the universal property of the free sheaf and its coordinate projections. Zero source or zero target indices require no equations. For an empty index type or no coefficients choose V=U.

theorem exists_shrink_finite_free_map_eq
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type v} [Finite ι] (A B : ι → Y.Modules)
    (hA : ∀ i, IsZero (A i) ∨ ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (A i ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (hB : ∀ i, IsZero (B i) ∨ ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (B i ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (y : Y) (U : Y.Opens) (hyU : y ∈ U)
    (f g : ∀ i, (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj (A i) ⟶
      (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj (B i))
    (h : ∀ i, (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).map (f i) =
      (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).map (g i)) :
    ∃ (V : Y.Opens) (_ : y ∈ V) (hVU : V ≤ U),
      ∀ i, (restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hVU)).map (f i) =
        (restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hVU)).map (g i)
